custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the physical plausibility of the rusted iron gate. AI often struggles with the complex occlusions and thin structures of barred gates. Check if the bars maintain consistent thickness and if their shadows align with the light source from the background. Also, evaluate if the 'decay' on the walls looks like natural weathering or if it has a 'painted-on' or smeared quality typical of diffusion models.
image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a dilapidated prison cell interior looking out through a heavy, rusted iron barred gate. The walls are made of crumbling concrete or plaster with significant peeling paint and exposed aggregate, indicating severe decay and abandonment. Through the bars, a bright outdoor courtyard or walkway is visible, contrasting with the dark, shadowed interior. The scene conveys a sense of confinement and historical neglect.

To confirm the scene is correctly classified as a prison/correctional facility environment and not just a generic old building.
To verify the structural integrity and connectivity of the iron bars, ensuring they don't merge incorrectly with the frame or background.
To assess the realism of the decay textures (peeling paint, rust) and identify any subtle generative artifacts in the lighting or noise patterns.
